headline: Binance Outflows Stabilise After Reopening Following $6.3 Billion Heist
summary: Binance saw customer outflows stabilise as the cryptocurrency exchange returned online following a $6.3 billion heist that intensified scrutiny over digital asset safety.
why: Major security breaches at dominant cryptocurrency exchanges test investor confidence and liquidity buffers across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Exchange security incidents create platform-specific volatility that can spill over into general crypto sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The successful return of the exchange online helped calm market panic and stabilize fund outflows after a massive exploit.
